name: Chaitanya
tagline: Eight years of turning messy data into reports people actually use. Now following everything that happens in AI, twice a day.
about: I build reports, dashboards and data models in Power BI, and have spent more than eight years in the IT industry doing it.
This site is my corner of the internet: what I work with, what I like, what I want next, and an AI Hub that keeps me up to date with the AI world every morning and evening.
